choice.basis: The chart 'Married couple vs Single women' shows the 2020 data points. The red dashed line (Single women) is at its highest point in 2020, while the blue solid line (Married couple) is near its lowest point. Visually, the 2020 count for Single women is significantly larger than the 2020 count for Married couple. The task requires opening the follow-up record for the group with the larger 2020 count.
choice.option_label: Open 2020 Single women demographic follow-up record
